runyth-compendium.summary: A travellers' guild of shelter-keepers, lantern-tenders, and people who leave a light on.

text.content:
The Porchlight Compact

The Compact is an arrangement older than most roads: keepers of wayhouses, monasteries, canal locks and lighthouses agree to light a lamp for arriving strangers and to pass travellers onward with a note of introduction. It has no masters, no dues, and no uniforms; it keeps a roster, a lantern token, and a stubborn etiquette.

Tokens and obligations

A member carries a lantern token, a cheap stamped brass charm. Showing a token to another keeper asks for shelter first and questions later. In return the member owes three duties: take the watch when offered, leave the shelter as you found it, and tell the truth about the road behind you.

Breaking an obligation does not expel a member; it flips the token, and a flipped token can only be righted by hosting the person you wronged.

pages.name: Using the Compact in your world

text.content:
Using the Compact in your world

Place hostelries and keepers along any route your players travel. The Porchlight Lantern in the Armory pack is a first-choice heirloom of Compact keepers; Hearthprayer in the Features pack is the small ritual a keeper teaches a promising guest.
